name: nixet
description: Build, run and debug Nixet agents from your editor.

interface.shortDescription: Build and run AI agents through the Nixet API
interface.longDescription: Create agents, publish immutable versions and run them with streaming output. The plugin adds skills for building an agent, running one, and diagnosing a run that behaved unexpectedly. Requires a Nixet API key, created in the console.
defaultPrompt: Build me a Nixet agent that answers support questions
Run my agent with streaming output
Why did my agent ignore its tools?
